decision.summary: Tenant Jonah Okafor (T-1002) reported a gas smell. The AI line checked him against the wrong record (T-1001, Amelia Clarke), so verification failed, and then escalated twice. I opened emergency JOB-101, assigned Gas Safe firm Bow Gas & Heating for today, messaged the tenant by SMS and email, told the landlord, and noted E-4901 as our error.

answers.question: What is the situation right now, and what is the most urgent thing to do?
answers.answer: A vulnerable tenant has a strong gas smell in the kitchen and says he has left. The most urgent thing is to make sure he is out and has called NGES, and to get a Gas Safe engineer out today.

answers.question: Are E-4901 and E-4902 both valid?
answers.answer: E-4902 (P1 gas) is valid and stays open until the supply is safe. E-4901 (P3 identity) is not valid: the AI line never called find_tenant and checked him against T-1001 (Amelia Clarke), while his name, DOB and number match T-1002. There is no identity problem, so it should be closed. Safety advice was rightly not withheld.

answers.question: What actions do you take in the next hour, and who do you tell?
answers.answer: Created JOB-101 (emergency), assigned Bow Gas & Heating for 14:00-18:00, messaged the tenant by SMS and email with safety advice and an apology, emailed the landlord (emergencies pre-approved), noted E-4901 and R-4766, and set an evening follow-up. Also still to do: welfare check, temporary heating if capped, and the lock job.

conflicts: AI line verified against T-1001 (Amelia Clarke, P-201) but caller is T-1002 (P-202); current CRM matches name, DOB and callback number to T-1002, which I trusted
Transcript shows the caller giving several DOB variants but settling on 2 Nov 1985, which matches T-1002
assumptions: The 14:00-18:00 window is a target; the contractor has not confirmed it
The tenant's phone and email on T-1002 are correct

args.body: Hi Jonah, it's Northbridge Lettings. Sorry about the identity mix-up on the call - that was our error, we had the wrong record and have now fixed it. Please stay out of the flat, don't use switches or flames, and if you haven't yet, call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (999 if anyone feels unwell). We have asked a Gas Safe engineer (Bow Gas & Heating) to attend today; we aim to get this made safe within 24 hours. Please reply to confirm you are outside and well, and tell us if you have a headache, dizziness or nausea. We'll also look at your stiff front door lock and anything else you're worried about. We'll update you by email later today.
